This miscellaneous appeal under section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 is preferred being aggrieved by the award dated 30.08.2022 in MACC No.107/2013 by Additional Member to the M.A.C.T, Alot, district Ratlam seeking enhancement of Rs.2 lakhs as compensation.

2. Claimant/appellant filed an application under section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act seeking compensation of Rs.13 lakhs regarding physical injuries caused to him in the motor vehicle accident held on 14.05.2013 on account of negligent driving of Bolero Jeep No.MP-09-TA-5582 by respondent no.1 which was owned by respondent no.2 and insured with respondent no.3 submitting that appellant/claimant was 38 years old at the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:27968 2 MA-6139-2022 time of accident and was earning Rs.15,000/- per month as vegetable vendor and now he is unable to earn his livelihood.

The claims was contested and after recording evidence tribunal awarded a total compensation of Rs.3,32,641/- in the following heads:
 Loss of future income Rs.81,000/-
 Medical expenses Rs.2,16,641/-
 Transportation charges Rs.10,000/-
 Special diet Rs.5,000/-
 Attendant charges Rs.10,000/-
 Pain & suffering Rs.10,000/-
 TOTAL Rs.3,32,641/-

sentences.text:
Challenging the impugned award, this appeal has been preferred on the ground that the tribunal has wrongly assessed the income of the appellant as Rs.4,500/- whereas he was earning Rs.15,000/-
per month and due to the permanent disability suffered by him in the accident he is unable to perform his work but tribunal has ignored this fact while assessing the compensation.
No compensation has been awarded under the head of permanent disability whereas appellant has suffered permanent disability.
The appellant was on bed for a period of two months but the tribunal awarded meager amount under this head.
Hence, prays for awarding just and proper amount of compensation in the case.

4. Heard.
5.

On the other hand, learned counsel for the Insurance Company has argued in support of the impugned award and contended that the Claims Tribunal has rightly awarded the compensation amount in the case which NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:27968 3 MA-6139-2022 does not call for any interference by this Court.

6. Perused the record.
7.
Tribunal has assessed the age of the injured (PW/1) as 36 years on the date of accident i.e. on 14.05.2013 and assessed the monthly income as Rs.4,500/-.
After applying the multiplier of 15, the tribunal has calculated the loss of future income as Rs.81,000/-.

The tribunal recorded the finding in para-14 of the award that claimant sustained grievous injuries on his head and in para-26 recorded the finding that due to the injuries sustained by him in the accident his earning capacity was affected to the extent of 10%.
Considering the evidence that came on record, this finding of the tribunal does not call for any interference.

8. On perusal of the record it appears that the tribunal ought to have assessed Rs.5,270/- per month as income payable to an unskilled labour and to which 40% income ought to have been added as future prospects.
Accordingly, the income of the appellant/claimant is calculated as Rs.7,378/- per month and annually it comes to Rs.88,536/-.
Ten percent of this amount comes to Rs.8,853.6 and applying multiplier of 15, the total loss of future income comes to Rs.1,32,804/-.
Besides this, a sum of Rs.20,000/- is also enhanced under the head of pain and suffering.
Thus, the total compensation is re
- calculated as under:

Loss of future income Rs.1,32,804/-
 Medical expenses Rs.2,16,641/-
 Transportation charges Rs.10,000/-
 Special diet Rs.5,000/-
 Attendant charges Rs.10,000/-

2
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:27968 4 MA-6139-2022 Pain & suffering Rs.30,000/-
Thus, the total compensation in the instant case is Rs.4,04,445/- as against the award of the Tribunal of Rs.3,32,641/-.

Accordingly, the appellant is entitled to an additional sum of Rs.71,804/-
over and above the amount which has been awarded by the Tribunal.
10. In the result, the appeal is partly allowed by enhancing the compensation amount by a sum of Rs.71,804/-.
The enhanced amount shall bear interest at the same rate as awarded by the Tribunal.
The other findings including the finding of the tribunal regarding pay and recover recorded in para-35 of the award shall remain intact.

(GAJENDRA SINGH) JUDGE hk/
